advice.why: Coming to the work with knowing the genre short cost about 5.1 points of the whole a piece: that’s preparation, not training.

20 hours of its exercise would take it from 94 to about 96, worth about 0.2 points a piece on your recent work (3 of your last 3 pieces read it; it gains most on The Spare Key (Hearing Him Out), Taped, about +0.3), worked out again with you as you are now, a session a day. Steady to begin; spaced pays once the last session is a day to a week old. About as useful: On Camera, Memory, Adaptability; any of them is a sound next step.
